earnPercent.title: Points earned (% back)
earnPercent.description: The share of what a shopper paid for the goods (without delivery and tax) given back as points when the order is delivered. 1 = 1% back.

pointValue.title: Value of one point
pointValue.description: What one point is worth at checkout, in the smallest unit of your currency (100 = 1.00 in a currency with cents).

minRedeem.title: Fewest points redeemed at once
minRedeem.description: A shopper redeems at least this many points on an order.

maxPercent.title: Most of an order paid with points (%)
maxPercent.description: Points pay at most this share of an order's total.

expiryDays.title: Points expire after (days or months)
expiryDays.description: Days, or calendar months with "Expiry counted in" months. 0 = never.

roles.title: Member roles that take part
roles.description: Accounts roles whose signed-in shoppers earn and redeem points. Empty = every signed-in shopper.

guests.title: Guests
guests.description: none: guests do not earn. earn: guests earn on their phone number and redeem once they sign in.

earnBase.title: Points earned on
earnBase.description: goods: what was paid for the items. total: the order total with delivery and fees.

earnAt.title: Points worked out
earnAt.description: delivery: when the order is delivered. placement: fixed when the order is placed, credited when it is delivered.

capBase.title: The most paid with points is measured on
capBase.description: order: the items after offers. goods: the items' full price.

redeemMode.title: Redeeming
redeemMode.description: amount: shoppers choose how many points. maximum: one switch redeems the most allowed.

expiryUnit.title: Expiry counted in
expiryUnit.description: days, or calendar months in your business time zone.

expiryRule.title: Expiry follows
expiryRule.description: at_earn: the setting when the points were earned. current: today's setting, so a change applies to past points too.
